[color=#00ffff][size=3][b]Overview
[/b][/size][/color]
In vanilla Stardew, passing out is a slap on the wrist.
You wake up at home, lose some gold, shrug, and do it again tomorrow.
[b]Where You Fell[/b] changes that.
Collapsing is no longer a throwaway moment – it’s a [b]decision[/b].
Where you push your luck, how late you stay, and who might find you all matter.
Gold, items, and XP are lost based on [b]where you actually collapsed[/b] and [b]who drags you back[/b], turning “death” into something you have to [b]think about and plan around[/b].
[line][b][color=#00ffff]Core Idea:
[/color][/b]
Risk is RealThis mod is built around one simple question:
[quote][i]“Is this floor, this monster, this extra hour really worth what might happen if I drop?”[/i][/quote]With [b]Where You Fell[/b]:
[list]
[*]Collapsing in the [b]mines or Skull Cavern[/b] means serious financial and progression risk.
[*]Collapsing in [b]town or the desert[/b] still hurts, but differently.
[*]Collapsing on the [b]farm or at home[/b] can be tuned to be relatively safe… or not, if you like to suffer.
[/list]Your death/collapse is now part of the strategy, not just background noise.
[line][b][color=#00ffff]What Actually Changes
[/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff7700]1. Location-based penalties
[/color][/b]
Every collapse is categorized into:
[list]
[*]Farm
[*]Home (farmhouse)
[*]Town
[*]Mines (mines, Skull Cavern, volcano, etc.)
[*]Desert
[*]Other outdoors
[/list]Each category has its own [b]base rules[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Gold loss %[/b] – how much of your carried gold is at risk
[*][b]XP loss[/b] – how much progress you lose in an appropriate skill
[*][b]Extra item loss[/b] – how many non-tool items can vanish in dangerous zones
[/list]You decide how punishing each area is:
[list]
[*]Make the [b]farm and home[/b] relatively safe, so you can limp back and crash.
[*]Turn the [b]mines and desert[/b] into genuine high-stakes runs where a collapse stings.
[*]Tune [b]town and other outdoors[/b] somewhere in the middle.
[/list][line][b][color=#ff7700]2. Rescuers with different consequences
[/color][/b]
You don’t just “wake up.” Someone (or something) finds you.
This mod adds [b]rescuer profiles[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Harvey & the clinic[/b] – professional care, expensive bill.
[*][b]Linus[/b] – you owe him in warmth and gratitude more than money.
[*][b]Joja Security[/b] – corporate rescue with corporate pricing.
[*][b]Adventurer’s Guild[/b] – they’ll haul you out, but gear tends to go missing.
[*][b]Spouse rescue[/b] – kinder outcomes if your partner drags you home.
[*][b]Junimos[/b] – whimsical, but still a little chaos.
[*][b]“Where You Fell”[/b] – sometimes you simply wake up where you dropped, aching and lighter.
[/list]Each rescuer:
[list]
[*]Has specific [b]locations[/b] where they can appear.
[*]Adjusts [b]how much gold, XP, and items you lose[/b], depending on your global intensity (Soft/Hard).
[*]Gives a different “flavor” to what death feels like in that context.
[/list]The result: [b]who[/b] finds you can be almost as important as [b]where[/b] you fell.
[line][color=#00ffff][b]4. Severity matters
[/b][/color]
Collapsing early in the night and keeling over at the last second aren’t the same thing.

[list]
[*][b]Mild collapse[/b] – earlier in the night, lighter scaling.
[*][b]Severe collapse[/b] – pushing right up against the clock amplifies penalties.
[/list]Staying out “just a little longer” becomes a gamble you actually have to weigh.
[line][b][color=#00ffff]Planning Your Death (So You Don’t Hate It)
[/color][/b]
With [b]Where You Fell[/b], “death” is part of your planning:

[list]
[*]Going for one more Skull Cavern level with a full backpack?
[list]
[*]You [i]might[/i] get a big haul… or lose a chunk of gold and items if you misjudge.
[/list][*]Farming all day when exhausted?
[list]
[*]Maybe it’s safe to drop in the fields – if your farm penalties are low.
[/list][*]Exploring new maps or dangerous areas?
[list]
[*]You can tune their punishment to match how risky they [b]feel[/b].
[/list][/list]The point isn’t to punish you randomly – it’s to make your [b]late-night decisions meaningful[/b].
[line][b][color=#00ffff]Configuration (GMCM Support)
[/color][/b]
Using [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], you can adjust:
[list]
[*]Enable/disable the mod entirely
[*]Switch [b]Soft / Hard[/b] global penalty intensity
[*]Toggle each penalty type:
[list]
[*]Gold loss
[*]Item loss
[*]XP loss
[/list][*]Per-location gold loss percentages:
[list]
[*]Farm, Home, Town, Mines, Desert, Other
[/list][*]Base XP loss for:
[list]
[*]Farming, Combat, Foraging, Generic
[/list][*]Base extra item loss in:
[list]
[*]Mines & Desert
[/list][*]Maximum gold loss cap
[*]Optional detailed logging of collapses to the SMAPI console
[/list]You can make “death” a gentle warning… or something that actually scares you.
[list]
[/list][line]TL;DR

[b]Where You Fell – Location & Rescuer-Based Collapse Penalties[/b] turns passing out into a real part of your strategy:

[list]
[*]Your [b]location[/b] and [b]rescuer[/b] shape what you lose.
[*]Every collapse has [b]weight[/b], not just a flat fee.
[*]You’ll think about [b]where[/b] you push your luck, [b]when[/b] you stop, and [b]what[/b] you’re willing to risk.
[/list]Death isn’t a joke anymore. It’s a choice you make every time you stay out just a little too long.
